messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm going to change how per-model config is wired for the inference runtime. Plan is to stop mounting the big global ConfigMap at /etc/models/config.json for most model services and instead reference per-model Secrets for sensitive flags and use a small configmap for non-sensitive knobs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5724 :eyes:

alex: Which services will be affected? model-runtime? batch-loader? any legacy jobs?

maria: Affects model-runtime, model-gateway (canary only), and the importer job. batch-loader is unaffected. I'm planning a two-wave rollout: 1) canary model-gateway & model-runtime with env override; 2) flip default mount. Will leave a compat shim for importer.

kevin: Oncall note — we should do a canary first. Also confirm the Terraform change will not recreate the namespace or ConfigMap resource (we must avoid force-replace). Any terraform plan output?

maria: Here's the TF diff snippet that replaces the configmap data reference with a secret lookup. It's additive, not recreating the cm resource:

```
# before
data "kubernetes_config_map" "models" {
  metadata { name = "per-model-cm" }
}
# after
resource "kubernetes_secret" "per_model_flags" {
  metadata { name = "per-model-flags-${var.model}" }
  data = {
    flags = file("./secrets/${var.model}-flags.base64")
  }
}
```

maria: The K8s change in the deployment will mount the secret at /run/secrets/models.json and update APP_CONFIG_PATH to point there. For importer, I'll add a postStart hook to keep /etc/models/config.json for now:

```
lifecycle:
  postStart:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh","-c","ln -sf /run/secrets/models.json /etc/models/config.json || true"]
```

alex: That symlink sounds fine. One nit: use ln -sf, and add a readiness probe backoff so importer doesn't fail on first start. Also make sure RBAC allows reading the secret from its service account.

maria: Good catch — will add RBAC rule & readiness backoff. I'll also add a feature flag so orgs can opt into the new secret path: FEATURE_PER_MODEL_SECRETS=true

kevin: Also add a migration note to the runbook and KMS key ARN for secret creation. If you want, I can schedule a 10-minute maintenance window for the canary flip tonight.

maria: Please schedule the window, thanks. PR link again for reviewers: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5724 :shipit:

alex: Reviewing now, will leave comments inline. :+1:

devops-bot: terraform plan validated for non-destructive changes on staging (plan id: tp-20260317-7)

maria: Thanks all — will push a small fixup and request final reviews before EOD.
